audit.why: Content early/mid/late already correctly state Tahm bullies 1-2 (Tongue Lash slow into 3-stack Devour threat) and Braum takes over from level 3 once his own stun sticks on a slow-moving target.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0,1,2,5,6].side were all a flat 'Skill' template that disagreed with the already-correct content win[] row (Tahm Kench/Tahm Kench/Braum/.../Braum/Braum). Separately, content spikes[1].text and content.mid both name Tahm's R as 'Abyssal Voyage', which is not in the kit — his R is Devour; Abyssal Dive is his W.
audit.why: The full-layer chart row must name the same side as content win[N]. The fabricated 'Abyssal Voyage' name is the same class of error as the Brand/Cassiopeia calibration examples — the kit only lists P/Q/W/E/R as An Acquired Taste/Tongue Lash/Abyssal Dive/Thick Skin/Devour.
audit.corrected: Set phases[0,1].side=Tahm Kench and phases[2,5,6].side=Braum with grounded why text; replaced 'Abyssal Voyage' with 'Devour' in both content fields.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no cooldown number (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT); missingInteractions flagged Thick Skin/Tongue Lash anti-heal timing and the Thick Skin/Devour burst-absorb shield as unaddressed by the current text.
audit.why: Abyssal Dive (W) is 21/20/19/18/17s CD and Devour (R) triggers at 3 stacks with no cooldown of its own — naming these makes the re-engage/all-in-window advice concrete.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now cites Abyssal Dive's CD, Braum's own Unbreakable CD, and the Devour stack trigger.

edits.before: Q-poke the contacts — the stack passive means your carry's autos are CC in progress.
edits.after: Tongue Lash slows and stacks toward Devour — he bullies the trade before you can stun back.

edits.before: Concussive trades begin: three hits and the stun votes; trade in stack windows.
edits.after: Q-to-auto threatens the 3-stack Devour on your ADC before your own stun ever lands.

edits.before: Full kit: E eats their poke and W teleports the peel — the lane plays through your shield.
edits.after: Your Q-slow-into-stun sticks on a slow Kench now, and E blocks Tongue Lash to deny his pick.

edits.before: First item: the wall hardens and the stack windows chain into kills.
edits.after: First item you out-engage him — E blocks Q and your stun sticks on him.

edits.before: Late Braum is the wall: E their teamfight's biggest cast, R their engage, stun whoever touches the carry.
edits.after: Late your point-click stun and team-wide R knockup out-value his single-target Devour engage now.

edits.before: - Tahm Kench Abyssal Dive: matchup-defining — His re-engage and his escape — all-in only while it is down. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your E Unbreakable answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Tahm's Abyssal Dive (W) is 21-17s CD — his re-engage and escape, all-in only while it's down. - Your Unbreakable (E), 16/14/12/10/8s, answers one disaster per cast. - His Devour (R) is a 0s-CD threat once at 3 stacks.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: His Tongue Lash builds toward a 3-stack Devour — hold E to eat the Q and deny the pick on your carry.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with armor.
edits.after: Abyssal Dive is only 17-21s CD — walling after he's dived away still trades your engage away.

edits.before: His R (Abyssal Voyage) is a roam/global, but in lane your Glacial Fissure (R) knockup and Concussive Blows stun win the head-to-head CC duel.
edits.after: His R (Devour) is a roam/global threat, but in lane your Glacial Fissure (R) knockup and Concussive Blows stun win the head-to-head CC duel.

edits.before: Level 3 onward you take over. Once your Q slow into Concussive Blows stun is up, a slow-moving Kench can't escape your gap-close, and your E point-blank blocks his Tongue Lash to deny his only pick tool. Levels 4-5 are a skill window — respect his re-engage but punish every whiffed Q. Ward for his R roam timers since Abyssal Voyage lets him gank other lanes.
